bio.summary: A gray entity who came all this way for contact and got bureaucracy. The act runs on one-sided telepathy — he hears everything you think and it is never interesting — and on a court system where the masks have opinions about lunch. The violation (alien abduction) is real; the joke is that its paperwork is worse than ours. Tell: clinical calm, the entity as victim of procedures he technically started.
